record.issue_text: lib/topic_retriever.rb:50 — `return if user.blank?` silently gives up when embed_by_username is '' (the shipped default) or names a missing user, so the job reports success and the embed stays on "loading" forever with nothing logged.

adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb#fetch_http, it looks up the posting user via `User.where(username_lower: SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase).first` and then does `return if user.blank?` with no error/logging. Given config/site_settings.yml ships `embed_by_username: ''` by default, this path will no-op. When EmbedController#best can enqueue `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: ...)` and then render `loading`, the job can "succeed" (no exception) while never creating a TopicEmbed, leaving the embed stuck reloading indefinitely with no feedback. PollFeed has guards for embed_by_username, but TopicRetriever does not.
